⏺ Running the check command
  ⎿  $ python3 -c "print(1)"

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Auto mode can't check actions in this session

  Auto mode's safety check runs on the server. Your requests go through
  127.0.0.1:51214, and the check isn't getting through.

  You can stay in auto mode and approve each action that needs the check
  yourself.

  Or you can leave for accept edits mode, which has no safety check, and auto
  mode stays off. These then run without asking: file edits and commands such
  as rm and mv in your working folders, some tools, such as subagents and
  scheduled tasks, and anything allowed by rules that auto mode set aside,
